item.title: Best Laptops for Machine Learning in the Sciences (2025)
item.description:
If you’re a scientist working with data — whether it’s genetics, wildlife tracking, climate models, or bioacoustics — you’ve probably heard about machine learning. Maybe you’ve even tinkered with a few models in R or Python. But when it’s time to move beyond your office desktop or the campus cluster, you need a laptop that can handle real ML workloads.

We’ve curated the best laptops for scientific machine learning in 2025 — no deep learning engineer jargon, just powerful, reliable machines that work for real research.
